selections.reason: T032-B1-METADATA changes the shared v2 metadata codec; actual large-header and strict late-damage tests precede implementation. Per-member flush and actual-token carry observations qualify transport without claiming constant memory for arbitrary tokens.
The same WriteJournal/ReadJournal and region binding serve existing v2 image publication and canonical adapters; retain their actual decision/admission controls.
Metadata length and journal dispatch must reject unknown frames before v1 whole-file decoding and preserve supported reordered/whitespace v1 evidence.
Two immutable source-derived v1 frames are independent compatibility oracles for the changed shared journal dispatcher; Windows execution is explicitly separate from earlier Linux evidence.
Generation descriptors and region order change in the shared codec; six actual cold-generation cuts preserve exact generation bytes/absence and one decision.
